scope: Selected existing captures and timing evidence; no new hardware runs.
normalization: JSON reformatted; device home and save-profile directory names replaced in metadata/logs. Numeric values, flags, hashes and failure states retained. CSVs, images and analyzer copied byte-for-byte.
omitted: Game, driver and wrapper binaries; save/registry contents; raw GPU memory and full IOLOG; navigation images not used in visual reviews.
missing_artifacts: Free Battle has no loaded-maps record; use its manifest/pins and process/D3D logs for the recorded runtime identity.
